notes: The supplied English object 'him' of 'beat him' was given to αὐτόν rather than to δείραντες, which is the verb that requires it in English, leaving the participle a bare 'beat'. That contradicts the chapter's own treatment of the same participle-plus-finite-verb chain at 20:11, 20:12, 20:15 and 20:20, where an expressed pronoun goes to the verb that governs it in Greek and each supplied object goes to the verb requiring it in English. αὐτόν is governed by ἐξαπέστειλαν, so it takes the 'him' of 'sent him away'.
